Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
All 180 million cards in the initial print run of Jyhad were printed
from the same film; no changes were made, not even to fix typos. When
the "unlimited" edition comes out, it will be pretty obvious that the
change has occurred.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@hal.com Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
